clock_control_trace.semantics: Socket frame flushed means all its bytes accepted by kernel, not hub/native ACK. Offsets count the entire ordered stream, including non-clock frames.

dispatch_cpu_profile.longspan_semantics: RAM spans >=10ms; end-order append. Poll includes all work; handler includes journal_call; progress total includes hub/direct. Inclusive parents and children must not be summed. Diagnostic timing overhead, not capacity proof.
dispatch_cpu_profile.semantics: wait and handler totals exclude progress; progress total_inclusive contains hub_poll/direct_batch; do not sum parent and children. Async handler measures executing step only, not pending Future time. RAM only, diagnostic opt-in.

dispatch_stats.schedule: C/R cached handlers alternate in fixed quantum4; stop after a pair when either initial cap is used
dispatch_stats.side_span_semantics: max_wall/cpu are accumulated side service time per poll, including pump; not contiguous batches or single-callback spans
